steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Hm-hmm~♪ And this is the place?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Raymond Bernard. He left his keepsake with us 37 years ago.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: A fairytale collection?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Hm. It must be written by the child himself. It's very callow...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: But it leaves a deep impression in parts, too.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Show me, show me.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: 'One day, I will make everyone read the fairytales that I write.'

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Verbatim by him, on the first page.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Fairytales...

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: What I'll say is, I could choke on the smell of this place. And all the hooligans we've crossed! Shameful manners.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Beautiful childhood dreams, and wretched present.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Every undertaking feels just as disharmonious as this.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Whoever's outside, you can come in.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I've told you, I've got no money! I'm flat broke!

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I'm sorry... I'm not saying I won't repay...

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: But soon! Real soon, I'll have the money! Cross my heart!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: (Er... he shouldn't be in at this time.)

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: (Did Granny get something wrong?)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (I don't know. We certainly don't tend to run into things like this.)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (But there's a chance Granny set this up on purpose.)

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: (Why?)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (Because this is a fairytale.)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (And the fairy always shows up to the right person, at the right time.)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: I am Iris, Master of the Castle of Dreams, Keeper of the Cradle.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: As per our agreement, I've come to return something once left to the castle.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Oh, you're door-to-door people... Sorry, I'm not buying, couldn't afford it anyway.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: And to be deathly honest, I'm surprised your boss is sending little girls out to this lonely a place.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Honestly, why can nobody just listen politely until someone is done speaking?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: This is the fairytale collection you agreed to leave with the Castle of Dreams.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: ...Castle of Dreams? Sorry, not a brand I've heard of.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Where... Where did you get this?

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: You're pulling my leg!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Hey, what are you flustered for? The Castle of Dreams, the one from the fairytales, you know.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Iris is the heir, the fairy who gives children wonderful hopes.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Ting-a-ling! Fairytales are in fact real.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Seeing as the agreement is fulfilled...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: I think we'll be leaving now. We hope the fairytales you wrote stay with you forevermore.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: The fairy... Hold on, wait!

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Stop right there!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: What do you think you're up to?!

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Sorry... misunderstanding.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I've no clue if you're real or not... but—you look so much like it! So much!

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Your clothes... your speech, everything.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: What utterly rude remarks.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: We're not concoctors of lies here. Do you think we're swindling you?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Should we punish him?

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: No, no, okay.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Today is... a child's birthday, here at the orphanage.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I want you, as fairies, to come celebrate his birthday with me.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Give him... give him something as fine as a fairytale to remember.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: That's... what he wishes for, and all.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: The wish of a child?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: If what you're saying is true...

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: It is, true as all!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Creating and safeguarding wonderful memories for each and every child...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Yes, it is a fairy's duty.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Um... I need to tell you in advance, though, the boy might be a little... different.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Well, no, he's a good kid. But...

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Anyway, no matter what happens, please don't get mad at him.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: And most importantly, don't blow the act! I beg you!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: What's his name? How old is he this year?

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Jurian.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: He's turning... seven, no... let's say eight.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: You don't even remember his age?

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Eight... eight.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: (I think something's not quite normal about this man. Are you sure about going?)

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: (I'll be covering you, of course.)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (Grown-up or child, no one can fool a fairy when they lie.)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (He's not entirely told us the truth...)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (But what I'm more concerned about is the boy.)

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Jurian.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Where are you hiding?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: He's been sneaking glances at us the whole time. Maybe something's up with him?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: It might be... because you've been holding onto your scissors.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Hmph. Well, somebody's got to be keeping an eye on the grown-ups.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Careful!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Bena, you've scared him.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: He's just a child.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: You're... blue. Pretty.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Purple... dangerous...

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: (Hey!)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (No wonder Raymond said he was only eight.)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (He's been left to remain in that period, forever... a child.)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Good evening, Jurian.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: I'm Iris, the blue one.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Just like the sky when there's no sign of Catastrophe.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Iris... sky.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: That's Bena, the purple one. Poisonous wisteria.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: But her poison is only for bad people, who try to be sneaky.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Heheh.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: (You... Don't give me that!)

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Baddie...

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Uncle isn't baddie.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (He's hiding from us on purpose, and especially Raymond.)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (Is Jurian calling himself a bad person?)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Jurian, bad people don't meet the fairy from the stories.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Your uncle told me today was your birthday.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: ...Birthday.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: That's right, your birthday!

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Yes, birthday!

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Today's my birthday! Uncle.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: So the fairy from the stories is here, to celebrate your birthday.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Stories... fairy. New friend?

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Um... yes, yes, yes!

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Hello...

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Jurian, might hurt... dangerous.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Can't meet.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Oh, Jurian!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: He's done a runner.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: You didn't frighten him, did you?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: It wasn't me that scared him off.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (Why haven't I seen any more of the orphanage's children?)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (Are the two of them the only ones here?)

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Jurian, listen now.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Open up the door, okay?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Leave him be for a while.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: You'll only make him more nervous at this rate.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Sorry... I think it's been too long since he's seen a stranger.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: He's not usually like this... he's good.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Meet a fairy from the stories. Celebrate a birthday together.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Raymond, was that really Jurian's wish?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: I'll be frank, I've noticed how he avoided you the whole time.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Keeping a distance on purpose, even denying contact.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: He... fears you.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: No he doesn't!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Chop-chop!

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Agh... I'm sorry. I mean...

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Jurian's just a bit...

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Uncomfortable.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I haven't spent time with him in a long while, too, so...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (It seems I'm right.)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (The one longing for a fairytale here is Raymond, not Jurian.)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: You know liars are bad people, and bad people get banished from fairytale worlds.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I'm not, I'm not!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: If you don't want this story to end like that...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Is it just the two of you here? Where are the rest of the children?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Be honest this time.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: If you must ask.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: It was years and years ago, I only adopted a child out of a moment of softheartedness.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: But after that... well, more and more children came in, and before I even knew it, my place became an orphanage.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I didn't realize... my home would get so run-down over time, though. The state it's in now...

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: With so many years gone by, most of the children have left. Jurian's the only one who's stayed here.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: You've seen—how he is.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Oh, I think that's the cake people come to deliver.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Just hang around a while longer, just until we're done celebrating. Please, I'm begging you!

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: You're such professionals, honestly, I can pay you extra! You have my thanks a million times!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: How overboard.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: What are we, actors for hire from some flimsy Victorian theater? I hardly think we have hourly rates.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: They're all such lovers of the exquisite craft that makes up those stories—and yet they don't believe the fairytale happening right in their faces.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: The more elaborate stories are always married to reality in some form. It comes in clear indicators, like signs on emergency exits, the kinds of things that make people jump for joy as if they've been redeemed.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: But fairytales are too free, freeform to the point you might want to pray for something, but wouldn't even know how to start going about it.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: That's why grown-ups don't believe. What they're after is help that comes with a clear price tag, anywhere, anytime.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: But children will believe, because fairytales are the friends that accompany them. Even in the gloomy vales, there's no fear they're alone.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: That said, haven't you realized?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Raymond is the one who's truly hoping for a fairy.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Him? You can tell he doesn't believe in fairytales from a mile away.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: 'Fairies' always bring miracles, after all. The fact he doesn't credit fairytales hardly matters.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: As long as Jurian can believe, as long as he can have 'a perfect birthday'...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: He'll accept it.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Sounds like he's using us.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I'll tail him.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Just don't do anything rash, Bena.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: I'll take a look around. If we're going to construct a fairytale dreamland, we need to feel things out, think them through, know them top to bottom.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: And need I say, this is quite real. The child isn't feigning it. I can't just toss this aside.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: If Raymond does intend on doing anything bad...

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I'll be punishing him.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Chop-chop!

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: You really can't just hang on one moment?

steps.name: Greedy Mercenary
steps.text: We're in a hurry to get rich, us brothers.

steps.name: Brutish Mercenary
steps.text: Fork it over. Whatcha got this time?

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Just this much.

steps.name: Greedy Mercenary
steps.text: Oh, yeah!

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Quiet!

steps.name: Greedy Mercenary
steps.text: What? Scared your dumb boy's going to find out?

steps.name: Brutish Mercenary
steps.text: What's it matter if he does? Just do him in, job's done.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: And my money?

steps.name: Greedy Mercenary
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: You really are...

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: A bunch of terrible children.

steps.name: Brutish Mercenary
steps.text: The hell are you?!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: By the looks of things, plenty of children did once live here.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Almost all the rooms have been turned into child's bedrooms, and the place is littered with child-sized odds and ends.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: It's odd though... Jurian's room is so far away from all the rest of them.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: It's not even on the same floor.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: But it is very close to Raymond's.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Is this a group photo of them all?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: One... two...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Thirteen children.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: And Jurian's absent?

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Hmm, hmm~♪ Why do we always travel so far flung, out from the city, through village old and young~♪

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: No soul to answer, no soul to care, the shepherds leave the beasts in the wild to fare~♪

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Don't shed a tear now, don't let it hurt...

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Audrey, sit here.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Peewee, next to you.
A rusted silver-gray teapot, a faded building block...
These items lacking any life are, one by one, given names by Jurian.
In Jurian's nebulous perception, they are, and have always been, his playmates.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Good evening, Jurian.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Oh, what's wrong?

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Mess! Mess!

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: You can't make messy!

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Spoon, knife...

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Fork, fork...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Ah, I'm so sorry about that.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: There, now we're all in place.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Mmm... can't make messy...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Do you remember me?

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Mm. Blue.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Color like no Catastrophe. Friend.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: That's right. No Catastrophe in the sky.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Won't you introduce me to all your lovely little friends?

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: ...Jurian, can't touch.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Really, what a way to treat a fairy who's come to visit. It's incredibly rude, you know.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: If that's how it must be...

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Now come wisplight and lamplight, come light up the way~♪

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Come to our little tea party to stay~♪
The eyes of the 'children' are like a stage growing in all directions.
From afar comes a fairytale forest's morning breeze, wafting through the curtains.
The flames upon the candlesticks entwine like partners for the ball.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Here come the guards, and they dance and sing for us~♪

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Carrying scissors to chop-chop away~♪
Jubilation.
Hops, skips, and jumps.
This is the magic that children are given.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Really beautiful! Pretty!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Not every child is lucky enough to witness a fairy's magic, you know.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: So you must be a tremendously exceptional one.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Fairy, new friend...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Of course Miss Fairy is your friend.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Jurian, scared, to hurt friend.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: A fairy is a friend that can't be hurt, you know. Not by anyone.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: A friend who'll always be by your side.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Mmm?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: If you lie, you're a gloompincer.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Audrey, this one. Talks a lot.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Peewee, always plays with me. Friend.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Ronnie, angry. Loud.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (The teapot with no lid is the talkative Audrey.)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (The faded building block, his best friend Peewee.)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (The necklace inlaid with jewels, the tempersome Ronnie.)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (These must be the things his past friends left behind.)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Jurian, can you answer a few questions for me?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Remember, if you lie, you're a gloompincer.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Mmm! If you lie, you're a gloompincer!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Well, then...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Raymond. Uncle. What is he?

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: ...Uncle, always looking after Jurian. Looking after family.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: So why do you always hide from him?

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Uncle, won't see me.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: I'm... a bad person, hurt Uncle.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Your friends, the other children. Where did they go?

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Friends. Friends all gone.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Jurian hurt friends! Gone!

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: All gone!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Chop-chop!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Bad child caught!

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Bad child! Jurian, bad child!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: She doesn't mean you.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Jurian, bad child!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Bena, what's going on?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I sneaked my way over, but never saw even a hint of delicious birthday cake.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Instead, I found this rotten boy selling off any valuables here to a bunch of awful silly billies.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Wait! Listen, I can explain!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: You're not exactly a first-timer either, are you?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Where are the other children? You can't have sold them off too, can you?

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Uncle...

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Jurian?! What are you doing out here?!

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: (Hushed) Can we please talk about this in private?

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: (Hushed) At least not in front of Jurian.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Heheh! Not a chance.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Purple... bad.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Jurian!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Goodness!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Arts?! He doesn't even have an Arts Unit!

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Jurian! No!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Watch out!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Bena, you said Raymond was selling things off?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Quite right.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Jurian, wait!

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Let go! Uncle can't touch!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: You won't hit me!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Bena, no making a scene!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Really, the lot of you are incorrigible children.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Raymond, come here.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: *sigh*.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Were those your partners in crime?

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: (No!)

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Baddie!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Chop-chop!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Jurian, you must listen to the fairy.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: We're off to find your friends.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Friends!

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: (There's still children here? Where?)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (Hmph. Nowhere. You did sell them all off, after all.)

spans.text: sell them all off, after all.)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (Inside every shipment of goods you sent off, I imagine.)

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: (No, that's ridiculous! I was only selling...)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (The longing and yearning Jurian has for his friends...)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (...is placed within the objects that signify them.)

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: (Eh?)

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (What exactly was it that happened?)

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Well?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Hm... I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but he's been infected.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: How? All the other children are clearly fine.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: How bad is it? Serious?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Serious or not, that's not your concern right now. You should be worried for yourself.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: If... they find you've got an Infected here, then you won't just be legally hamstrung...

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: You'll put the rest of the children in peril.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Uncle, going out? Going out!

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: I, I'll carry stuff, this luggage.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Jurian, come with me.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: You're moving onto this floor now. It'll be... easier, for your Uncle to look after you.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: And you have to tell me before you go downstairs.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: If you want to go play, I'll play with you.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: No buts!

a.text: Did I do a—do a bad thing?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: You never realized?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: How hurt, how panicked he'd be when he couldn't find his friends?

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I... I thought it was just stuff he couldn't find.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I thought he just talked to those things because he was so bored.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: They're not things. They're friends.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: His most precious friends, ever since you drove everyone away from him.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Save it!

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: What choice did I have?

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Look at the state of me, a noble... heheh, heh...

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I don't think anyone else except me would have even taken him in.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: But I'm threadbare... selling valuables is the only way I can get by.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Raymond...

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: There was nothing I could do! Nothing!

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I don't have the first clue about Oripathy... I was scared it'd spread to the other children.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: But I... I couldn't abandon Jurian.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Hurt... friends...

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: If you get close, hurt.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Uncle is, good person.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Sorry... I know you mean well.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: You're professionals through and through.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: But fake, in the end, is fake.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Fake...

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Can't find... friends?

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: No need for pretenses now. You can take all the money I got selling the stuff.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I'd be lost for anything on the off-chance you got infected. You'd best go.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Fairy... blue, is fake?

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Sorry, Jurian. I shouldn't be lying to you.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I just wanted to...

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Jurian! Come back!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Jurian!

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Where are you going?!

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Leave... Jurian wants to leave.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Then... Audrey, and Peewee, and... they'll come back.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Jurian is leaving.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Don't, get close!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Jurian, just hold it!

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Blue, color like no Catastrophe.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: I really like, the stories in, dining hall.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Jurian, can't control.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Dangerous purple, dangerous.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Drastic measures it is.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: It seems naughty children need to be taught a little lesson!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: (Bena, drag Raymond over as well!)

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Dark! Where is Jurian?

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Where is this?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Don't be afraid. I'm by your side.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Blue.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: There is a person holding onto you. Are they hurt?

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Hand... blue... not like blue.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Answer me, now. Are they hurt?

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: No... very warm.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Holding tight... Jurian can feel, pulse.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Very fast pulse.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Then you can open your eyes now.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: The one holding your hand is your uncle, Raymond.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Do you see? You won't hurt anyone.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: *cough* Ahem...

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Well, this is a little... embarrassing.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Jurian, not purple.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: You're blue too. Okay?

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Mmm. No Catastrophe in the sky.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: The purest, clearest sky.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: But... Jurian's friends.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Remember the wish you made to me?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: That's your agreement with the fairy now.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Once made, it's never to be broken.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: As for you. Hmph.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: As is perfectly clear, you built a candy house straight from a fairytale by your own two hands.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Even as it melted and crumbled bit by bit, you never chose to leave.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: But somehow, you forgot the most important thing.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: What... What did I forget?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: *sigh*... What a stubborn, blind grown-up you are.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: No wonder nobody of age has found their way to the Castle of Dreams in so long.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Do you have on you, right now, the item you left with the Castle?

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Eh? Oh, oh, oh.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: The children hid inside their home, but with a single puff, the terrible beast blew off their roof.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: The children panicked and ran outside, but with a single tap, the ferocious beast destroyed the last things they had.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: With nowhere left to go, the children followed a trail of breadcrumbs, and in the forest they found a candy house.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: That candy house you built for them was as sturdy as a castle.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: And that is a fairytale ending.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: But what kind of ending is it, really, to have nothing aside from a castle?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: The evil witch may well gobble up everyone within.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: The tyrant king would soon make slaves of them all.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: What really matters is what stories take place inside the castle.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: What did you write on the first page?

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: 'One day, I will make everyone read the fairytales that I write.'

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Yes, fairytales.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: We see to it that wonderful, hopeful fairytales take place, inside those tiniest castles in the depths of every child's heart.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: We use the castle to keep them safe and sound, to protect them.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Don't we?

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: And yet all I gave them was fear.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I'd forgotten the fairytales I wrote myself.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: But you still believe.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: How else would Bena and I be here?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: And of course, it isn't just for your sake.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: It's for Jurian's, too.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Blue... Iris. Blue is called Iris.

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: A fairy, right?

steps.name: Jurian
steps.text: Are... you really real?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Indeed I am.
So thought Jurian as he woke up in the forest. He remembered how if he followed the forest trail, he would find the way to the Castle of Dreams.
Jurian walked and walked, until he found a teapot with no lid.
It was the talkative Audrey.

a.text: 'Jurian, Jurian! You've got to hear this, yesterday, I saw a manglerbeast in the forest burying honey in the ground.'
'And then he walked around and around, and around and around, waiting for the honey to grow, hahahaha!'

steps.text: Jurian and Audrey walked and walked, until they found a necklace inlaid with jewels.
It was the tempersome Ronnie.

a.text: 'Hmph! I was waiting forever for you.'
'Are you thick, Jurian? Manglers don't bury honey, they wouldn't do that.'

steps.text: Jurian and Audrey and Ronnie walked and walked, until they found a faded building block.
It was the faithful playmate Peewee.

a.text: 'We're almost to the Castle of Dreams!'

steps.text: Jurian and Audrey and Ronnie and Peewee walked and walked.
Until a path in the forest opened up before them.
There, the castle, every bit as dreamlike as its name, opened its grand gate wide.
Out before them came but a fairy dressed in blue, who gave an elegant greeting.

a.text: 'I am Iris, Master of the Castle of Dreams, Keeper of the Cradle.'

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: I've had a talk with Granny. Jurian will be staying at the Castle of Dreams.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: He'll greet and guide every child lucky enough to pay the Castle a visit.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Thank you. Really, I don't know how to thank you enough. That you'd do all this for Jurian.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: You needn't thank us.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: It's the fairytale ending children ought to have.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: Mm, mhm.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I've sold off the manor and the rest of my belongings, and found a new place in the city, and a new job.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I'll be working with orphanages for as long as I live.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I'll see that every child hears my fairytales.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Once something is returned from the Castle of Dreams, the time magic loses its effect.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: You'll have to take care of your fairytale collection yourself from now on.

steps.name: Raymond
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Then I believe Jurian, and the rest of the children, will very much look forward to the day they can hear of the fairytales you write.
